summary: Kidz AI Inc. filed Amendment No. 1 (424B5) to its prospectus supplement updating the maximum at-the-market offering of up to $12,455,000 in Class B common stock under a sales agreement with Chardan Capital Markets. The filing is a routine follow-on equity shelf takedown, not a special situation. Shares are sold at prevailing market prices; no premium, fixed price, or tender is involved. Chardan receives a 3.0% commission. The company's stock (KIDZ) closed at $0.3537 on June 3, 2026. No board recommendation or deal mechanics apply. This is an ordinary capital raise, not a restructuring, going-private, or other special event.
